information.description:
Vultures are the biggest bruisers among most scavenger groups, often sporting heavy weapons, dense bullet-resistant clothing, and a hearty build. While they don’t hold a candle to most milspec units, a Vulture can be solid opposition for inexperienced crews or ambushed civilians, which of course are a Vulture’s favorite mid-day snack.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Scavengers).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Sometimes all you need is a warning shot to scare off your attacker, but if that doesn't work, you'll need something more convincing. The M2067 Defender from Constitutional Arms will almost certainly do the trick. This light machine gun was designed for all the righteous, upstanding citizens living in dangerous neighborhoods. With a remarkably high firing rate, large magazine and automatic reload, in the right conditions someone holding one of these could take out a whole army.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Requires BODY 8+ to wield unless Mounted, and BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms to not reduce the user’s MOVE by 2 while wielded. A Nomad may choose to receive this weapon when they first install a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.

  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

Originally intended for special operations use, this quickly-abandoned implant enables projecting a one-way holographic mask over the user’s face, entirely obscuring it while still providing full vision.

External Body Cyberware. While active, this cyberware masks the user's face from external sources, including cameras. Anyone attempting a Human Perception or Lip Reading check against users with this cyberware active takes a -2 penalty to their check. Counts as an instance of Gang Colors Jewelry for Scavengers, if tweaked to the right display setting. Turning this cyberware on or off takes an Action. NOTE: This is the digital facemask that Scavs use in 2077. The World of 2077 book specifically mentions “K.E.R.S” for the Scavengers, so that’s what this was inspired by.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
